definition.pair: bridge_choose_pair chooses object and place independently; both must be chosen, otherwise the whole pair is no_pair and reasons records both slot exits
definition.twenty: the 20 describe sentences must each yield the expected pair and text
definition.unknown: an unknown query yields no_pair with object and place reasons no_choice
definition.ambiguous: a sentence with two objects yields no_pair; object reason ambiguous_read and place reason no_choice
definition.correction: correcting CUP to GREEN changes object and text, keeps place TABLE, moves the table digest, and leaves the subject tensors unchanged
definition.no_bridge: a state without a table yields no_pair with both reasons no_bridge
definition.closed_state: the nine legacy closed-state readings stay equal before and after

criteria.correction: before object CUP / place TABLE / text '蓝色杯子在木桌'; after object GREEN / place TABLE / text '绿色瓶子在木桌'; digest changes; subject hashes equal
criteria.inert: parameter and state hashes equal before and after all pairs
criteria.closed_state: the nine legacy readings stay equal before and after
criteria.rerun: the R27 anchor carries a commit, a runner blob sha1, a runner sha256 and a core sha256
